set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols mpls label-switched-path l.explanation: Configure the label exchange path (LSP) for MPLS to use the LDP protocol.

parameters.name: lsp-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the label exchange path.

set protocols isis level 1.explanation: Configure the level of the ISIS protocol.

wide-metrics-only.explanation: Configure level 2 of the IS-IS protocol to use width only.

disable.explanation: The `disable` command in Junos deactivates a configuration statement or hierarchy, making it non-operational without removing it from the configuration.

set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0.explanation: Enables an IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

level 1.explanation: Configure the level of the ISIS interface.

point-to-point.explanation: Configure the interface type of the IS-IS protocol as a point-to-point.

set protocols isis interface lo0.1.explanation: Enables an IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

level 1.explanation: Configure the level of the ISIS interface.

passive.explanation: Configures the ISIS protocol ' s lo0 interface to passive mode.

point-to-point.explanation: Configure the interface type of the IS-IS protocol as a point-to-point.

set protocols isis lo0.1.explanation: The command `set protocols isis [parameter1]` configures a specific parameter for the IS-IS routing protocol in Junos OS, enabling or modifying its behavior.

address-family inet unicast.explanation: The command `address-family inet unicast` configures the routing instance to support IPv4 unicast routing within a specific protocol or routing context.

address-family inet unicast prefix-sid i.explanation: The command assigns a Segment Routing (SR) prefix SID index to an IPv4 unicast route, enabling MPLS label allocation for the specified prefix.

parameters.name: index
parameters.explanation: The index value of the prefix SID.

set protocols isis no-advertise-mac.explanation: The command explanation is: **Prohibit IS-IS from advertising MAC addresses.**

set protocols isis no-advertise-protocol.explanation: The command explanation is: "Disable IS-IS protocol advertisement."

set protocols isis sr-mpls.explanation: Enable the Segment Routing MPLS feature for IS-IS.

set routing-options dynamic-tunnels segm.explanation: Enable the Segment Routing MPLS functionality for dynamic tunnels.

set routing-options dynamic-tunnels segm.template: set routing-options dynamic-tunnels segment-routing mpls label-range-page [parameter1] [parameter2]
set routing-options dynamic-tunnels segm.command: set routing-options dynamic-tunnels segment-routing mpls label-range-page 16000 23999
set routing-options dynamic-tunnels segm.explanation: Configure the label range for Segment Routing MPLS.

parameters.name: start-label
parameters.explanation: The starting value of the label range.

parameters.name: end-label
parameters.explanation: The end value of the label range.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.1.1/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.
